# Mobile Culinaire

> Temporary mobile kitchen trailer rental across the USA. Commercial-grade, code-compliant units manufactured in-house in Portland, Oregon. Part of the Marvel Buildings family.

Mobile Culinaire rents fully equipped, turnkey mobile kitchen trailers to hotels, resorts, country clubs, universities, hospitals, and food service operators nationwide. All units arrive pre-wired, pre-plumbed, and NSF-compliant, ready to connect to on-site utilities. Minimum lease term: 1 month. Nationwide service, plus Caribbean and Africa.

---

## Models

- [32' Mobile Kitchen](https://www.mobileculinaire.com/mobile-kitchens/32-mobile-kitchen): Compact trailer for boutique hotels, private clubs, and small event venues. Fully equipped with commercial-grade cooking, refrigeration, and ventilation equipment.
- [40' Mobile Kitchen](https://www.mobileculinaire.com/mobile-kitchens/40-mobile-kitchen): Mid-size unit for 4-star hotels, country clubs, and university dining during renovation. Full commercial kitchen layout with prep, cooking, and cold storage zones.
- [53' Mobile Kitchen](https://www.mobileculinaire.com/mobile-kitchens/53-mobile-kitchen): Full-size trailer with walk-in cooler and walk-in freezer. Maximum capacity for 5-star hotels, large resorts, and high-volume event venues.
- [2x53' Mobile Kitchen](https://www.mobileculinaire.com/mobile-kitchens/2x53-mobile-kitchen): Double-unit side-by-side configuration with walk-in cooler, walk-in freezer, dry storage room, and dishwashing room. For large resorts, stadium catering, and emergency deployments.

---

## Services & Support

- [FAQ](https://www.mobileculinaire.com/faq): Answers covering permits, utility requirements (electrical, water, gas), equipment options, lease terms, installation timeline, and client responsibilities.
- [Resource Center](https://www.mobileculinaire.com/resource-center): Operational guides on electrical sizing, water supply, fire suppression, propane regulations, towing requirements, staff training, and event rentals.
- [Projects](https://www.mobileculinaire.com/projects): Case studies from real deployments across senior living facilities, municipal programs, country clubs, and hospitality venues.
- [Contact / Quote Request](https://www.mobileculinaire.com/contact): Request a quote or get information on available models, lead times, and lease options.

---

## Projects

- [Front Porch Communities – San Francisco](https://www.mobileculinaire.com/projects/senior-living-san-francisco): 53' unit supporting 400–500 daily meals during a 5-month kitchen renovation at a California senior living community.
- [City of Portland – Transitional Housing](https://www.mobileculinaire.com/projects/homeless-center-oregon): 40' unit deployed over 3 years, delivering 200–300 daily meals for a municipal housing program in Oregon.
- [Menlo Circus Club – Country Club](https://www.mobileculinaire.com/projects/country-club-california): 53' unit maintaining uninterrupted food service during a major kitchen renovation at a California polo club.

## Resources

- [Mobile Kitchen Electrical Requirements](https://www.mobileculinaire.com/resource-center/mobile-kitchen-electrical-requirements): How to size electrical power (208V or 480V 3-phase) for a mobile kitchen trailer deployment.
- [Water Supply for Mobile Kitchens](https://www.mobileculinaire.com/resource-center/mobile-kitchen-water-supply): Tanks, connection types, and flow rate requirements for commercial mobile kitchen trailers.
- [Fire Safety & Suppression Systems](https://www.mobileculinaire.com/resource-center/mobile-kitchen-fire-safety-suppression-extinguishers): Suppression system specifications and extinguisher requirements for code-compliant mobile kitchens.
- [Propane Safety & Regulations](https://www.mobileculinaire.com/resource-center/mobile-kitchen-propane-safety-regulations): Safety requirements and regulatory compliance for propane-powered mobile kitchen configurations.
- [Mobile Kitchen Towing Requirements](https://www.mobileculinaire.com/resource-center/mobile-kitchen-towing-requirements-cdl): Weight limits, hitch specifications, and CDL licensing rules for towing mobile kitchen trailers.
- [Mobile Kitchen Rentals for Events](https://www.mobileculinaire.com/resource-center/mobile-kitchen-rentals-events-guide): How temporary mobile kitchen rentals work for event venues, what's included, and when to use one.

## Key Facts

- 10+ years in the mobile kitchen rental industry
- 400+ units manufactured and deployed to date
- Nationwide service across the USA; international deployments in the Caribbean and Africa
- 48-hour lead time for shipping
- Minimum lease term: 1 month; options range from 0–3 months up to 1 year or more
- All units manufactured in-house at Portland, Oregon
- Part of the Marvel Buildings brand family; sister brands: Modular Culinaire (permanent prefabricated kitchens, formerly ContekPro — contekpro.com) and Marvel Buildings (modular support units: showers, dishwashers, temporary housing)
- Units have 5× the lifespan of average retrofitted kitchen trailers
- All units NSF-certified and code-compliant across US jurisdictions
- Notable clients: Boyne Resorts, Six Flags, Discovery Land Company, Southworth Development, Fluor Corporation
- Serves: hotels, resorts, country clubs, golf courses, universities, hospitals, catering companies, senior living, event venues
